tenderSchedule.title: Supplying of Workforce (Man Power) Required for Annual Maintenance of Water treatment plant and Distribution network of Kadur TMC on Outsource basis
tenderSchedule.description: Outsourcing the services of senior valvemen, Helpers, Plumbers, Water supply operators and Water supply Assistants, Water supply staff for the drinking water supply in Kadur Municipality and for the water purification unit of Kadur-Birur Bhadra Combined Drinking Water Project

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Tender Documents: The bidder shall submit all certificates, declarations, registrations, experience certificates, financial documents and other documents specified in the tender

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
WAGES SHALL BE PAID TO WORKERS REGULARLY THROUGH BANK TRANSFER OR OTHER APPROVED MODE WITH IN THE PRESCRIBED PERIOD Proof of wage payment shall be submitted to Kadur TMC whenever required
Safety : The contractor shall provide necessary safety equipment PPE to workers wherever required and shall ensure compliance with applicable occupational safety requirement
Registration: The bidder shall be a legally registered firm/company/agency and shall possess a valid registration certificate for providing manpower/services under the applicable laws
MINIMUM WAGES : THE CONTRACTOR SHALL BE PAY THE DEPLOYED WORKERS NOT LESS THAN THE MINIMUM WAGES PRESCRIBED BY THE GOVERNMENT OF KARNATAKA ALONG WITH APPLICABLE STATUTORY BENIEFTS

Right of TMC: Kadur TMC reserves the right to reject the bid of any bidder who fails to satisfy the prescribed eligibility conditions or submits incomplete/false documents, subject to the applicable procurement rules.
The tender work order will be issued for one year, and the contract will be continued up to 3 years on the basis of Municipal Administration Decision and As per CPHEEO Guidelines.
TMC Kadur Reserves all the Rights of the Tender.
